pillar_2a_capital.text:
`srep_capital_add_on` starts from a supervisory Pillar 2A add-on ratio and answers: what capital amount does that ratio imply, and what is the Total SREP Capital Requirement (TSCR) once Pillar 1 is added? You give it `pillar1_requirement`, `pillar2a_addon_ratio` and `risk_weighted_assets`, and it multiplies the ratio by risk-weighted assets, then adds Pillar 1.

`pillar_2a_capital` works the other way round. It answers: what is Pillar 2A capital when I add up the individual risk charges, such as credit concentration, IRRBB, pension and operational? You pass `risk_addons` and `risk_weighted_assets`, and it sums the add-ons and expresses the total as a ratio of risk-weighted assets.

In short, one converts a ratio into an amount and a TSCR, while the other builds the amount from components and derives the ratio.

explain.text: `srep_capital_add_on` (SREP Capital Add On) converts a supervisory Pillar 2A add-on ratio into a capital amount and then into the Total SREP Capital Requirement (TSCR). It takes three inputs: `pillar1_requirement` (the Pillar 1 capital requirement in currency), `pillar2a_addon_ratio` (the add-on as a fraction of RWA), and `risk_weighted_assets` (total RWA). The Pillar 2A capital is the ratio multiplied by RWA, and the TSCR is that amount added to the Pillar 1 requirement. It sits in pyvar's Regulatory & Compliance domain.

when.text:
`srep_capital_add_on` (SREP Capital Add On) fits when you need to turn a supervisory Pillar 2A add-on into a capital amount.

- You already have the Pillar 2A add-on as a fraction of risk-weighted assets (`pillar2a_addon_ratio`) and want it as a currency figure.
- You want the Total SREP Capital Requirement (TSCR), which adds the Pillar 2A amount to your Pillar 1 requirement (`pillar1_requirement`).
- You have total risk-weighted assets (`risk_weighted_assets`) on hand and want a capital view built from them.
- Your starting point is a single ratio, not a list of separate risk add-ons.

If Pillar 2A is instead built up from individual risk add-ons, `pillar_2a_capital` is listed as the sum of those add-ons.
